picks.rationale: Choose Stroud at $5,700 after the official team recap documents 312 yards and three TDs in London. Pair him with Noel at a modest combined cost; last week's efficiency is not a projection.
Pay $6,700 for Hubbard's recent rushing workload: 28 carries for 120 yards in Week 6. Keep touchdown and receiving expectations separate from that one-game role evidence.
Retain Allen's 17-carry, two-catch role while the new official export flags Hall OUT. This is conditional on Hall's actual Week 7 availability; the export is not the Friday injury report.
Keep Puka as the one Rams player in this build, at the newly verified $8,400. Seven Week 6 targets keep opportunity on the board; a rebound is a judgment, not a guaranteed outcome.
Keep one Giants pass catcher for his 15 Week 6 targets. McCarthy's relief performance does not establish a full-game passing baseline; quarterback/protection uncertainty remains.
Use Godwin as a $4,300 WR with eight Week 6 targets. The backup-QB environment limits confidence; this is salary relief with observed involvement.

Replace the $5,300 Likely candidate with $4,800 LaPorta to reduce shared Giants risk. Detroit's last game before its bye produced five catches and 88 yards for LaPorta; those results do not set next week's expectation.

Use Noel's $3,900 FLEX price to pair with Stroud. The team confirms four catches for 107 yards and a TD in London; explosive production on only four receptions makes this the most fragile receiving-volume assumption.
Choose Tennessee's $2,600 DST slot as budget relief against Cleveland, whose Week 6 offense scored 13. This is not a claim of a dominant defense or a predictable turnover total.
